Game Overview

In Jelly Phil 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a bouncy journey with Jelly Phil 2. Navigate intricate 2D labyrinths, dodge jelly foes, and master the art of double jumping through eight thrilling levels. Carefully time your moves to collect pink jellies and reach the exit. Adventure awaits in this charming arcade platformer sequel!
